# recipe-switch

> Switch how your AI coding tools think and work. `recipe-switch` is a zero-dependency Node.js (≥ 22) CLI and localhost web panel (`127.0.0.1`) that installs, switches, customizes, and rolls back behavior recipes — Main, Subagent, and Independent system prompts plus User, Subagent, and Result per-turn steering reminders — across 11 AI coding harnesses, with unified diff previews, automatic backups, hand-edit drift protection, and saved file bytes/source spans for rollback (see recovery limits below).

- Repository: https://github.com/NB-Corp/recipe-switch
- Default Recipe Source: https://github.com/NB-Corp/gpt-with-taste
- Documentation (English): https://nb-corp.github.io/recipe-switch/
- Documentation (简体中文): https://nb-corp.github.io/recipe-switch/zh/
- License: MIT

## What a Recipe Contains

A behavior recipe (`recipe.toml` or an author repo like `gpt-with-taste`) defines up to six coordinated instruction texts:
- `main`: System prompt for the primary interactive coding agent.
- `sub`: System prompt for delegated subagents.
- `independent`: System prompt for standalone/autonomous tasks.
- `userSteer`: Per-turn reminder injected on user turns.
- `subSteer`: Per-turn reminder injected on subagent turns.
- `agentSteer`: Per-turn reminder injected when a subagent or task returns results.

Recipes can also declare boolean checkbox options (`[options.<id>]`) that customize prompts via `when`/`unless` item filtering, whole-slot `prepend`/`append`, or Markdown section-level `[[options.<id>.patch]]` (`prepend`, `append`, `before`, `after`, `replace`, `remove`).

## Safety Notes Worth Surfacing

- **Hard-link preflight**: exact pre-write bytes are stored as content-addressed blobs. Hard links publish complete temporary files without replacing a new destination. Preview probes the target directory; file systems without hard-link support (FAT/exFAT, some network drives) are refused with a "safe writes cannot be guaranteed" notice.
- **Recovery race**: if hard links become unavailable and recovery falls back to rename, a target externally recreated between the absence check and rename will be overwritten. Stop other writers before recovery. Pending recovery reports current/expected fingerprints, backup location and recovery steps in CLI/API/UI.
- **Displaced versions**: each affected file path keeps at most its latest carrier. Same-volume carriers in backups and cross-volume carriers beside targets follow the same retirement rules, including uninstall. The cutoff is that one read when the tool's next operation retires the old version; later old-handle writes are not guaranteed to survive. Changed bytes become a later-version blob before deletion. Uninstall may create a new latest carrier.
- **Private storage and target permissions**: state, pending journals, blobs, operation backups, probe records and temp files are secured before payload, including existing files and explicit Everyone/Users grants. Windows removes non-user grants but may retain existing SYSTEM/Administrators grants; POSIX uses 0700 directories and 0600 files. Existing target DACLs or POSIX owner/group and mode are copied to empty temp files before payload; recovery without a permission source uses private permissions. Failure stops writing.
- **Authorization**: models, providers and credentials are not changed. OpenClaw conversation access requires explicit UI opt-in and is restored on uninstall; existing false/deny settings are never overridden, even with --force.
- **Original backups per install cycle**: one snapshot per installation from a clean state, never overwritten within the cycle, dated next to the restore button. Uninstall or restore-to-pre-install ends the cycle, retires the snapshot, and immediately releases unreferenced blobs. Upgraded installs backfill from old records; incomplete originals are marked "reconstructed version (重建版本)" and require extra confirmation. The restore button is disabled when already at the pre-install state. Storage permissions follow the private-storage rules above, including the existing SYSTEM/Administrators exception on Windows.

## Supported AI Coding Harnesses (11)

- `codex` (**OpenAI Codex**, `~/.codex` / `CODEX_HOME`): Writes `prompts/recipe-switch/{main,sub,recipe.json}` and sets `model_instructions_file = "…" # managed by recipe-switch` in `config.toml`.
- `claude` (**Claude Code**, `~/.claude` / `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`): Writes `recipe-switch/{main.md,independent.md,recipe.json}` and `recipe-switch/plugin/`. Never edits `settings.json`; prints the `claude --append-system-prompt-file … --plugin-dir …` launch command.
- `kiki` (**Kiki**, `~/.kiki` / `KIKI_HOME`): Writes materialized package under `recipe-switch/packages/<id>/` and sets `recipe = "<package>" # managed by recipe-switch` on selected `[models."<alias>"]` entries in `config.toml` (requires `--models`).
- `pi` (**Pi**, `~/.pi/agent` / `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`): Installs built-in extension in `extensions/recipe-switch/`; switching rewrites `recipe.json` (hot-reloaded per request; optional `--providers` and `--model-pattern`).
- `dsh` (**DeepSeek Harness**, `~/.dsh` / `DSH_HOME`, one target per profile under `profiles/<p>/`): Installs Cordis bundle `dsh-recipe-switch` in `.recipe-switch/` and `node_modules/` and registers it in profile `package.json` (optional `--root-role main|independent`).
- `omp` (**Oh My Pi**, `~/.omp/agent` / `OMP_CODING_AGENT_DIR`): Installs `gpt-with-taste` OMP adapter under `extensions/recipe-switch/`.
- `grok` (**Grok Build**, `~/.grok` / `GROK_HOME`): Writes marked global rule file `rules/recipe-switch.md` alongside existing rules.
- `opencode` (**OpenCode**, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode` / `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`): Writes `recipe-switch/main.md` and adds its path to `instructions` in plain-JSON `opencode.json`.
- `kimi-code` (**Kimi Code CLI**, `~/.kimi-code` / `KIMI_CODE_HOME`): Writes marked `SYSTEM.md` (`${base_prompt}` + Main), installs `plugins/managed/recipe-switch/{kimi.plugin.json,steer.mjs,recipe.json}`, and registers it in `plugins/installed.json`.
- `hermes` (**Hermes Agent**, `%LOCALAPPDATA%/hermes` on Windows or `~/.hermes` / `HERMES_HOME`): Installs `plugins/recipe-switch/{plugin.yaml,__init__.py,recipe.json}` and enables it in `config.yaml` (`plugins.enabled`). Uses Python (`python` or `py -3`) to AST-parse host source without executing it, requiring a direct, undecorated and unshadowed `register_middleware` method on `PluginContext`. If Python, parsing or the static signal is unavailable, installs per-turn steering only and reports `unsupported` (Main/Sub unavailable). Otherwise runtime evidence determines `unknown`, `registered` or `confirmed`; static eligibility alone never confirms activation. (`codex_app_server`, auxiliary, and max-iteration summary calls bypass the plugin.)
- `openclaw` (**OpenClaw**, `~/.openclaw` / `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` / `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`): Installs `extensions/recipe-switch/` (`before_prompt_build` plugin) and enables it in strict-JSON `openclaw.json`. Conversation access is not granted by default: `allowConversationAccess` is written only when the user explicitly checks the UI opt-in (and restored on uninstall); an explicit `allowConversationAccess: false` blocks installation outright.

*(Detected but intentionally uncovered: **Gemini CLI** `~/.gemini`, **Cursor** `~/.cursor`, and **Qoder** `~/.qoder`.)*

## Key CLI Commands

```sh
# Inspect harnesses, active recipes, and hand-edit drift
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs status [--json]

# List available recipes and checkbox options
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs recipes [--json]

# Manage recipe sources and gpt-with-taste adapter checkout
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs sources [add|remove <path>] [--gwt <dir>]

# Preview (dry run) or apply (--yes) an install or switch
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs install <harness> <recipe> [--home DIR] [--with a,b] [--without c] [--yes]
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs switch  <harness> <recipe> [--home DIR] [--with a,b] [--without c] [--yes]

# Roll back the latest operation or uninstall all operations
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs rollback  <harness> [--home DIR] [--yes]
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs uninstall <harness> [--home DIR] [--yes]

# Inspect operation history or restore pre-install original state backups
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs history          <harness> [--home DIR]
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs originals        <harness> [--home DIR]
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs restore-original <harness> [--home DIR] [--yes]

# Start the localhost web panel on 127.0.0.1:4517 (or run the isolated sandbox demo)
node bin/recipe-switch.mjs ui [--port 4517] [--no-open]
node scripts/demo.mjs --reset
```
